kind: simulation: real page script, stub chrome object, in Chrome for Testing

checks.name: An endless feed: Scroll to the end first reads every batch once, shows its counter with Stop, and scrolls back
A lazy feed: batches that take 900 ms and 1,500 ms to arrive are waited for
A page with nothing to load ends at once; a feed that scrolls inside its own box is scrolled there
A feed that removes old items as it scrolls: links the page removed are kept, none twice
A feed that never ends stops at 50 screens, and says the page may have more
It also stops at 5,000 links, and when its time is up (2 minutes; checked here with a lowered limit)
Stop on the page, Escape, and Stop from the workbench each end the scroll at once, keep what it had, and scroll back
Inside a longer run the notice shows the run’s counter and keeps Stop; the background’s messages update it; Escape stops the run; afterward it closes itself
Next is found as <link rel="next">, <a rel="next">, and a link named next by its text, aria-label or title, in 12 spellings
No Next: none, a link switched off, a link to this same page, a script address, a hidden link, and words that only look like it; a button is told apart
At 320 px the notice fits, and its text and Stop have at least 4.5:1 contrast in light and dark themes
